tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B the right.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “What does your sister read?” (Add do, does or did yourself.)

B hears the question and puts the verb in the right form: she reads (present simple), I ate (past simple), she has written (present perfect: have / has + past participle). Irregular verbs must be learnt: go, went, gone.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Finally: swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: Went is the past simple. Gone goes with have.

tandemRedemittel.p1: Sorry? Can you say that again, please?
